# Erdos.p1113 — Erdős problem 1113

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/1113
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/1113.lean`, theorem `erdos_1113.variants.filaseta_finch_kozek`, AMS 11).

**Filaseta–Finch–Kozek conjecture (2008).** Every Sierpiński number is either a perfect power
or possesses a finite covering set of primes.

## Statement
∀ k, k.IsSierpinskiNumber →
      k.IsPerfectPower ∨ HasFinitePrimeCoveringSet k

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
